answer: Opal-sonnet citation bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files one citation of real work, a key-bound 14-line opal sonnet naming work, key, epoch. An auditor replays it on the opal registry; a missing or mismatched citation is a fable, no fable survives replay, and the bond burns. First 30, k-th 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 in fees, rewards max 40,000. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps bond and reward.
